general-como-funciona.question: How does Impulso Jobs work for candidates and companies?
general-como-funciona.answer: Candidates create their profile, build their resume and apply from a single dashboard. Companies post openings, review candidates and follow every hiring process from theirs.

general-ciudades.question: Can I use the platform from any city?
general-ciudades.answer: Yes. Impulso Jobs covers all 32 states of Mexico and supports on-site, hybrid and remote openings. You can filter by state, municipality, work mode and professional field.

general-soporte.question: Where do I get help with a specific question?
general-soporte.answer: Write to us from the contact page or straight to our email. This section will grow as we release new features.

empleos-publicacion.question: Where is my opening shown once it is published?
empleos-publicacion.answer: The opening appears in the public list, in searches by professional field and by state, and on each field page. If your plan includes promotion, it is also marked as featured.

empleos-tiempo.question: How long does it take for a job posting to go live?
empleos-tiempo.answer: In most cases the posting is available right after you complete the form. If it needs extra validation because of its content or the company details, the team reviews it as soon as possible.

empleos-postulaciones.question: When will I start receiving applications?
empleos-postulaciones.answer: As soon as the opening is visible. The volume depends on the profile you are looking for, how clear the description is, the salary and the work mode.

pagos-cupon.question: How do I redeem a coupon or promo code?
pagos-cupon.answer: While purchasing or activating the plan you will find a field to enter the code. If the coupon is valid and still active, the discount is applied automatically before you confirm the payment.

pagos-facturacion.question: Do I get an invoice or receipt for my payment?
pagos-facturacion.answer: Yes. Every purchase generates a receipt and, where applicable, the invoice with the company tax details: RFC, tax regime and CFDI use. It is worth keeping them up to date in the profile.

pagos-cancelacion.question: What is the cancellation and plan change policy?
pagos-cancelacion.answer: Write to support to change plans or sort out a billing matter. Each case is reviewed based on the state of the service, the benefits already used and the terms in force.

cuenta-password.question: How do I reset my password?
cuenta-password.answer: From the sign-in page you can use the password recovery option. You will receive a temporary link by email to create a new password securely.

cuenta-seguridad.question: Is my personal and company information protected?
cuenta-seguridad.answer: Yes. We apply security measures to protect access, sensitive data and activity inside the platform. On top of that, each user can only manage the information their role allows.

cuenta-perfil.question: Can I update my profile or company details after signing up?
cuenta-perfil.answer: Yes. Both candidates and companies can edit their information, contact details and preferences from their dashboard. Keeping the profile up to date improves the quality of applications and visibility.
